unit: synchronized qualified WIN/WDO bars under already-admitted source semantics
return_definition: log close-to-close return on synchronized bars; signals use only data timestamped no later than decision time

model_classes.conditioned: same inverse-direction rule gated only by frozen ex-ante regime states
model_classes.complexity_limit: no post-validation feature additions or threshold optimization

temporal_split_policy.discovery: earliest contiguous 50% of eligible synchronized history
temporal_split_policy.historical_holdout: final contiguous 20% ending at the pre-prereg cutoff
temporal_split_policy.prospective: strictly post-prereg observations only after separate prospective activation
temporal_split_policy.embargo: one maximum tested prediction horizon between adjacent historical partitions

economics.cost_schedule: reuse the already-preregistered canonical WIN/WDO cost convention only; if exact applicability cannot be proven, fail closed before economics

survival_conditions: predictive direction is not explained solely by lag zero contemporaneous correlation
validation and historical holdout retain same directional economic expectation after costs
effect is not concentrated in a single short historical regime
regime variables are observable ex ante
conditioned model improves on static benchmark in validation and holdout without post-hoc retuning
automatic_rejection_conditions: net economics non-positive under applicable frozen costs
sign or economics collapse across long horizons or distinct regimes
regime-conditioned model fails to improve robustly on static benchmark
source semantics or synchronization cannot be proven without causal backfill
multiple_testing_policy: All listed horizons, lags and regime candidates are one frozen family search space; discovery selects at most one static specification and one conditioned specification for untouched validation. No validation-driven reselection.
